note: Trego County (KS) parcels are only served through the state ORKA property viewer. ORKA's public GeoServices folder holds only KS_ORKA_Extras (partial, no Trego parcel polygon layer) and sketch. Parcel data for a county is obtained through the ORKA request process, which requires registration and per-county approval (2-3 weeks). No public queryable Trego parcel service was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online searches or on county sites (tregocountyks.gov has no GIS link). Commercial vendors (Regrid, acres, mappingsolutionsgis) are paid and not county sources.
